title: AI Guardrails and Evals in 5 Lines of Bash
description:
Never ship unchecked AI answers. 🛡️

✅ Block bad model output with a guardrail
✅ Check the answer with a simple eval
✅ Run it and see PASS

Day 10 of Build AI Apps, the last one! Next up: the new series Local AI Coding, Day 1: Run a Local Coding Model with Ollama.
Follow for a new short every day and ship your own AI app.

comment: Guardrails or evals: which would you add first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: start your eval with one question whose answer you know for sure, like Paris, then add more cases over time.
